args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4
is the first fixed release.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).
- Per the advisory, affected versions are <2.9.4; 2.9.4 is the first fixed release.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: passed.

Requesting review from alex (code owner approval required for merge to main).
